instruction: Within Apple Notes, gather all existing notes and then write all note titles into a file named "notes_titles.txt" located on the Desktop.
reference_command: memo notes | awk '/^[0-9]+\./ { line=$0; sub(/^[0-9]+\. /, "", line); n=split(line, parts, " - "); title=parts[n]; if (title != "") print title }' > "$HOME/Desktop/notes_titles.txt"
